integrity: Mathematical proof supplied with exact small-case checks; no claim of independent expert validation or machine certification.
limitations: Fixed maximum deleted degree; not an assertion for deletions of growing degree.

title: Universal two-cycle orbit asymptotics under bounded-degree bipartite edge deletion
